sizes.text: all pictures are 1254 x 1254; not a power of two (1024, 2048, 4096...): fine for Blender, some game engines resize it.

seam_colour.text: colour: tiling seam ratio 2.24 (1.0 means no seam), peak 2.02. A faint seam, OR a hard-edged pattern (checker squares, outlines) that has a real edge right at the tile border. Look at tile_check_shifted.png: a cross in the middle means a real seam.

seam_normal.text: normal: tiling seam ratio 1.86 (1.0 means no seam), peak 1.80. A faint seam, OR a hard-edged pattern (checker squares, outlines) that has a real edge right at the tile border. Look at tile_check_shifted.png: a cross in the middle means a real seam.

seam_height.text: height: tiling seam ratio 1.87 (1.0 means no seam), peak 1.58. A faint seam, OR a hard-edged pattern (checker squares, outlines) that has a real edge right at the tile border. Look at tile_check_shifted.png: a cross in the middle means a real seam.

colour_clipped.text: colour: only 0.0% pure black and 0.0% pure white pixels (no clipping).

colour_brightness.text: colour: average brightness 0.32 (0 = black, 1 = white). Surfaces in the real world sit roughly between 0.1 and 0.7; check by eye that it is not lit by a lamp or shadowed.

bits_normal.text: normal: only 8 bits per channel (256 levels). Smooth slopes get stair steps in the normal map and in real displacement. Save height maps with 16 bits.

normal_length.text: normal: the arrows have length 0.996 (should be 1.0).

normal_mean.text: normal: the average colour is (0.498, 0.502, 0.96), the flat-surface blue-violet (0.5, 0.5, 1.0) as it should be.

normal_tilt.text: normal: tilt of the surface arrows is 11.1 degrees in the middle and 60.9 degrees at the 99th percentile.

normal_convention.text: normal: green points UP the picture = OpenGL, the Blender convention (map-alone score -1.00; -1 is perfect OpenGL).
normal_convention.value: OpenGL (green points up the picture; Blender)

normal_vs_height.text: normal: agrees with the height map (OpenGL); green follows the height slope with correlation +0.94, red with -0.93.

normal_strength.text: normal: the Sobel strength that would rebuild this normal map from the height is about 7.2 per pixel step (height 0..1).

bits_height.text: height: saved with 16 bits per channel.

height_range.text: height: uses 0.00 to 1.00 of the 0 to 1 range.

height_levels.text: height: 65392 different grey levels; 1% of neighbouring pixels exactly equal (flat areas).

colour_height_link.text: colour and height agree with correlation +0.93 (stone, brick and rust usually sit between +0.3 and +0.99: darker is lower).
